name: Dungeon Finder keeps Vaults of Inquisition and Road to De Other Side disabled
contract: PR #4763 removes Vaults of Inquisition (map 936, LFGDungeons 401, 1401, 2401) and Road to De Other Side (map 937, LFGDungeons 402, 1402, 2402) from Dungeon Finder with `disables` rows of type 8 (DISABLE_TYPE_LFG_MAP). LFGMgr::IsDungeonDisabled decides whether LFGMgr::InitializeLockedDungeons gives a dungeon LFG_LOCKSTATUS_RAID_LOCKED, which removes it from the random pools and from direct selection. It asks DisableMgr about the row at normal difficulty and DisableMgr answers from the row's flags, so a row with flags 0 disables nothing. Every tier of both dungeons must read as disabled, while Deadmines (6), which has no row, stays enabled.
